marketing_description: The Philips LED Filament Bulb, part number 576496, offers 450 lumens of soft white light with a color temperature of 2700 K and a color rendering index of 90. This 4.4 W bulb has a medium E26 base and is designed to work with 120 V systems. It is dimmable and has an average life of 15000 hours, and is also Title 20 Compliant.
